evidence: Labeled P2P and modifies outbound message queuing and transport validation in src/net.cpp and src/net.h.
rationale: Prevents memory corruption and aborts in P2P transport encoding. As noted in the description, 'An oversized type aborts V1 encoding. V2 sends it under a truncated type with its payload intact, or writes past its encoding buffer when the payload is shorter than the excess type bytes.' Enforcing limits in CConnman prevents out-of-bounds writes and peer disconnections from oversized messages.
